text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Copies of the academic transcript both the original and a copy notarized by the Chinese Embassy * 2. Study plan in China * 3. Electronic photo(JPG) Pixel quality must be greater than 1M. * 4. The applicant’s passport Passport must be valid beyond the intended period of study in China. * 5. No criminal record certificate notarized by the Chinese Embassy. * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. A copy of the highest academic certificate * 8. Original of the highest academic qualification notarized by the Chinese Embassy. The applicant who is still at school has to submit a certificate of attendance or pre-graduation certificate issued by the school currently being attended. Moreover, after admission, the applicant must submit the original academic qualification and a copy notarized by the Chinese Embassy. 9. Certificates of various awards during study or work * 10. A photocopy of the Foreign Physical Examination Record This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese health and quarantine department and a blood test report. Applicants should strictly follow the guidelines of the Foreign Physical Examination Record. The Foreign Physical Examination Record is invalid if it is incomplete, without the signature of the doctor and the official stamp of the hospital, or without the photo of the applicant and the cross-page seal on the photo. The applicant is requested to do the medical examination within the 3 months before arriving in China. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. AIDS laboratory report(a seperate report) * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
